scientific_limitations_and_integrity: Exact Q_2 closure only for even n>=4 and odd c. The split density criterion and unweighted n-th-power-equivalent classes are acknowledged as prior-covered. Results for c not congruent to +1 or -1 modulo 2^(v_2(n)+2) are the new exact nonsplit classifications. Finite checks are not an infinite proof. Unindexed implicit earlier classifications remain a risk. Independent audit not performed.
title: Exact 2-adic quotient closures of weighted even-power binary forms
